not_found.why: Per-segment sources-of-profit tables (הרכב הרווח הכולל, one per segment) sit on the board-report pages as images with no text layer; only the group table is extractable.
Only the motor property (רכב רכוש) claims-and-expenses ratio is printed as text; compulsory motor, other lines and total P&C ratios are not printed in text (any such tables are images).
No nostro asset-class allocation table is printed in the Hebrew report text; investment composition by asset class is not given.

Note tables by portfolio group print profit before tax; a comprehensive-profit row (after OCI) is printed only in some period tables (annual and prior-year columns), so it is not available for every window.
No loss ratio separate from the claims-and-expenses ratio is printed.
Investment contracts (pure savings, IFRS 9) have no line-of-business table in the notes by portfolio group; they appear only in the separate additional-data note.

Board-report composition tables on pp. 113-118 are images with no text; line-of-business figures were therefore taken from financial-statement note 4 tables (results by principal portfolio groups), source stated in each fact note.
